overview.startPoint: Talk to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the TzHaar City's main plaza.

extra.label: League auto-complete
extra.html: Unlocking Karamja will auto-complete the quest.

notes: Throughout this quest there will be objects on the ground, toggling the graphic setting "Textures" to off can make it easier to see said objects.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Any pickaxe (tool belt will work)
A TokKul-Zo for increased damage against enemies and teleports around the TzHaar City
items.text: A TokKul-Zo for increased damage against enemies and teleports around the TzHaar City

blocks.html: Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the main plaza of TzHaar City.
blocks.text: Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh in the main plaza of TzHaar City.

blocks.html: Run east through the arch. A cutscene will begin.
blocks.text: Run east through the arch. A cutscene will begin.

blocks.html: Run north-east to the Birthing Pool and speak to TzHaar-Mej-Het.
blocks.text: Run north-east to the Birthing Pool and speak to TzHaar-Mej-Het.

options.text: That's the TokKul I'm looking for!

blocks.html: Run around the wall to where the Fight Kiln entrance is, and mine the Statue of TzHaar-Ket-Teg.
blocks.text: Run around the wall to where the Fight Kiln entrance is, and mine the Statue of TzHaar-Ket-Teg.

blocks.html: Run south-west to the TzHaar City entrance. Mine the nearby Statue of TzHaar-Xil-Kal.
blocks.text: Run south-west to the TzHaar City entrance. Mine the nearby Statue of TzHaar-Xil-Kal.

blocks.html: Return to the main plaza. Melt the two stacks of fragments into TokKul with the furnace slightly south-east of the main plaza.
blocks.text: Return to the main plaza. Melt the two stacks of fragments into TokKul with the furnace slightly south-east of the main plaza.

blocks.html: Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh again.
blocks.text: Speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh again.

blocks.html: Go to the entrance to the Library, north-west of the main plaza and speak to Ga'al.
blocks.text: Go to the entrance to the Library, north-west of the main plaza and speak to Ga'al.

blocks.html: Run south until you reach the cooking icon on the minimap. Speak to the next Ga'al.
blocks.text: Run south until you reach the cooking icon on the minimap. Speak to the next Ga'al.

blocks.html: Continue south along the eastern wall to the southwest corner of the city (east of the TzHaar City mine), and speak to the final Ga'al.
blocks.text: Continue south along the eastern wall to the southwest corner of the city (east of the TzHaar City mine), and speak to the final Ga'al.

blocks.html: Return to the main plaza and speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh again.
blocks.text: Return to the main plaza and speak to TzHaar-Mej-Ak or TzHaar-Mej-Jeh again.

blocks.html: Enter the Fight Kiln entrance east of Main Plaza.

blocks.html: A cutscene plays.
blocks.text: A cutscene plays.

options.text: We have to take the risk. Reforge the Ga'al in the Kiln.

blocks.html: Run to the easternmost part of TzHaar City, where a cave entrance is. The entrance is not clickable until after you interact with the orb, cave entrance is indicated on your map.
